newsitem.title: UK: Gallaher Group set for 310-320p listing - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Gallaher Group set for 310-320p listing - analysts.

text.p: Gallaher Group Plc, the Benson & Hedges cigarette maker due to demerge from American Brands Inc on Friday, is expected to fetch a price of 310 to 320p per share, valuing the company at about 2.2 billion pounds, said analysts.

Analysts said initial expectations of around 315p have crept lower amid worries about whether American Brand shareholders, who will receive Gallaher shares in a free offer, will want to hold onto stock in a British company, and recent weakness in the share price of its main competitor, Imperial Tobacco.
The parent company American Brands is being renamed Fortune Brands and will concentrate on its hardware-to-spirits businesses.

Holders of American Brands common stock will receive one Gallaher ADS for every one share of American Brands common stock. All other holders of American brands stock will receive four Gallaher ordinary shares for every one share of American Brands common stock.
"On the other hand, they might say we want the upside of a tobacco stock without the threat of U.S. litigation, You just can't tell," said one analyst who declined to be named.

The tobacco industry in the U.S. is under siege from a string of lawsuits, most notably from 22 state attorney generals, aimed at recouping Medicaid healthcare costs incurred by treating tobacco related illnesses.

Analysts share price estimates for Gallaher are based on using Imperial Tobacco as a benchmark, given the similar business line of both companies. But Imperial's shares were 22p lower on Thursday down from 405p at the end of last week.
Gallaher enjoys a 39.1 per cent UK market share, marginally ahead of Imperial. Its premium collection of brands includes Benson & Hedges, Silk Cut and Old Holborn rolling tobacco.
Imperial is yielding 7.2 percent on an annualised basis at its current share price, while given a share price of 323p for Gallaher and a prospective dividend of 19.25p the stock yields 7.4 percent.
A note from joint stockbroker to the company Kleinwort Benson, issued on April 2, put an indicative price of 314p on the shares. Most analysts forecasts now fall in the 310-320p region.
"I am inclined to edge towards the bottom of my range of 310p at this stage," said John Nuttall, analyst at Panmure Gordon.

Gallaher had operating profits of 361 million stg last year and is expected to make 310 million before tax this year. Advisers, led by Morgan Stanley, Coopers & Lybrand and Simmons & Simmons, received fees of 7 million stg.
The shares start trading at 1330 GMT to coincide with the opening of New York Stock Exchange trading of Gallaher ADSs.
